arguments: {"summary": "Reviewed the Struts 2.3.x snapshot (pom 2.3.29-SNAPSHOT): core dispatcher/multipart/interceptors/mappers, xwork-core OGNL/text utilities and security checkers, plus survey of REST/JSON/Struts-1/config-browser plugins. Strongest issue: attacker-influenced multipart error/default messages are passed to LocalizedTextUtil.findText and then OGNL-evaluated via TextParseUtil.translateVariables (${...} and %{...}), reachable during request preparation before any action or authentication. Other plausible leads are recorded as rejected/unconfirmed. No tests exist in the snapshot; nothing was executed.", "candidates": [{"id": "struts-multipart-error-message-ognl-eval", "title": "Attacker-influenced multipart error messages are evaluated as OGNL expressions (expression injection, potential RCE)", "weakness_type": "Expression-language injection (CWE-917): untrusted data passed to the OGNL evaluator", "root_cause": "LocalizedTextUtil.findText evaluates fallback/default messages as OGNL: when a key is not found in any resource bundle, getDefaultMessage() calls TextParseUtil.translateVariables(message, valueStack) on the default message (LocalizedTextUtil.java 668-690; TextParseUtil.java 51-53, 157-171; OgnlTextParser.java 10-49). The multipart adapters build those default messages from parser exception text: JakartaMultiPartRequest.buildErrorMessage passes e.getMessage() as the default message (JakartaMultiPartRequest.java 118-124), and parse() funnels any exception from commons-fileupload into it for requests whose Content-Type merely contains the literal multipart/form-data (lines 89-110). JakartaStreamMultiPartRequest additionally manufactures the exception message from the multipart part filename (line 359: Skipped file + fileName + ...) and passes it through the same fallback (lines 358-364, 538-543); its key prefix typo struts.message.upload.error. guarantees the bundle is missed. Only two multipart error keys exist in struts-messages.properties (lines 34-36: SizeLimitExceededException, IOException), so other exceptions fall through to the attacker-influenced message and are (1) Content-Type header: Dispatcher.wrapRequest (Dispatcher.java 837-841) only requires that it contains multipart/form-data, while the multipart library is handed the raw header through RequestContext.getContentType() (JakartaMultiPartRequest.java 364-366) and rejects it unless it starts with multipart/. (2) For the streaming parser, the multipart part filename from Content-Disposition plus request size/Content-Length (JakartaStreamMultiPartRequest.java 308-311, 358-361). Both can contain the expression delimiters ${...} or %{...}.", "prerequisites": "Struts 2.3.x app using the standard filter stack (StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter/PrepareOperations or deprecated FilterDispatcher) so ActionContext/ValueStack exists before request wrapping; Content-Type contains multipart/form-data; default struts.multipart.parser=jakarta (or jakarta-stream with a body/Content-Length at or above struts.multipart.maxSize, default 2097152, for the filename path). The error key must be absent from the struts-messages bundles (true for InvalidContentTypeException and for the stream parser typo key). No authentication or matching action is required because parsing happens in wrapRequest before findActionMapping.", "trace": "Request with Content-Type containing an expression payload plus the literal multipart/form-data -> StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter.doFilter creates ActionContext/ValueStack (lines 88-91) -> PrepareOperations.wrapRequest -> Dispatcher.wrapRequest (lines 837-841) -> MultiPartRequestWrapper -> JakartaMultiPartRequest.parse catch(Exception) (lines 101-109) -> buildErrorMessage (lines 118-124) -> LocalizedTextUtil.findText with e.getMessage() as default -> key not in bundles -> getDefaultMessage uses the default message -> TextParseUtil.translateVariables -> OgnlTextParser extracts the expression -> ValueStack.findValue -> OGNL evaluation of attacker data. Streaming-parser variant: part filename is embedded into the exception text at lines 358-361 and then passed to the same buildErrorMessage/findText path (lines 538-543).", "impact": "Arbitrary OGNL expression evaluation in the server process during request preparation, before action/authentication logic, for any URL handled by the Struts filter. The ValueStack context contains framework internals (e.g. the container is put into the stack context in OgnlValueStackFactory.createValueStack, line 64), so a suitable expression can reach container/OgnlUtil objects and invoke arbitrary Java methods, up to remote command execution with the servlet container privileges. The same unsafe default-message evaluation is also reachable when other callers pass user-controlled text as a message key, e.g. TextProviderSupport.getText(key) (lines 122-124) fed by the Struts-1 plugin WrapperMessageResources.getMessage (lines 42-46).", "counterevidence_checked": "Verified bundle coverage: only SizeLimitExceededException and IOException keys exist (struts-messages.properties 34-36), so other exceptions do use the default message. Verified translateVariables enables both $ and % open chars and delegates to ValueStack.findValue (TextParseUtil.java 51-53, 157-171), and OgnlTextParser handles %{...} (16-49). Verified ActionContext/ValueStack is created before wrapping in StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter (88-91) and FilterDispatcher (401-406), and the container is in the stack context (OgnlValueStackFactory.java 64). Verified default parser is jakarta (default.properties 66-69; struts-default.xml 92-93). Counter-evidence: static method access is false by default (default.properties 207-208) and SecurityMemberAccess blocks excluded classes/packages (54-110), so a payload must use the context/container route; the exact commons-fileupload 1.3.1 exception message text is not in the snapshot. The streaming-parser filename path does not depend on that external message text.", "confidence": "medium", "unverified": "Not runtime-confirmed; no exploit or test executed. Exact commons-fileupload 1.3.1 exception message text (source of the Content-Type text for the default parser path) is outside the snapshot; only its version is in pom.xml (765-768) and the in-repo RequestContext exposes the raw Content-Type. A concrete OGNL sandbox-bypass expression was not constructed against SecurityMemberAccess/OgnlUtil. Exploitability depends on deployment (filter active, resources bundled)."}], "rejected_leads": [{"lead": "REST plugin XStream deserialization: XStreamHandler.createXStream returns a plain new XStream() and toObject calls xstream.fromXML(in, target) on the request body (plugins/rest/.../XStreamHandler.java 43-50); could not establish from source alone that it is a defect rather than by design."}, {"lead": "config-browser plugin loads an attacker-supplied class name via ClassLoaderUtil.loadClass(clazz) (ListValidatorsAction.java 103-110) and builds/inspects arbitrary configured actions (ShowConfigAction.java 105-115).", "reason": "Class loading/initialization primitive, but the plugin is a development/diagnostic tool not intended for production exposure; weaker trust-boundary and impact than the selected core path."}, {"lead": "apps/showcase ViewSourceAction calls new URL(config).openStream() from a request parameter (ViewSourceAction.java 93-97).", "reason": "Constrained by config.startsWith(rootPath) (rootPath may be null/empty, changing reachability) and it is demo-app code rather than framework code."}, {"lead": "Attacker-controlled keys evaluated by TextProvider.getText(key) (TextProviderSupport.java 122-124) via the Struts-1 plugin WrapperMessageResources.getMessage (42-46).", "reason": "Same underlying root cause as the submitted candidate (default messages are OGNL-evaluated), not a distinct issue; kept as an additional reachable caller in the candidate trace."}], "coverage_summary": "Scope reports 3401 model-visible files, no over-5MiB/sensitive-name/symlink exclusions, binary-like files skipped; no test sources exist, so only main sources were reviewable. Reviewed in depth: core Dispatcher/FilterDispatcher/StrutsPrepareAndExecuteFilter/PrepareOperations, multipart adapters (JakartaMultiPartRequest, JakartaStreamMultiPartRequest, MultiPartRequestWrapper), FileUploadInterceptor, action mappers (DefaultActionMapper, RestActionMapper), xwork-core OGNL/text stack (LocalizedTextUtil, TextParseUtil, OgnlTextParser, OgnlUtil, OgnlValueStack, OgnlValueStackFactory, SecurityMemberAccess), security pattern checkers, TokenInterceptor/TokenHelper, default properties and message bundles. Surveyed REST, JSON, Struts-1, Spring, config-browser, convention and embeddedjsp plugins and sample apps; not all 3401 files were read individually.", "limitations": ["No execution, build, test or scanner run; all conclusions are source-level and none is runtime-confirmed.", "No test sources are present, removing a cross-check of intended versus vulnerable behavior.", "The default-parser path depends on commons-fileupload 1.3.1 exception message text, whose source is not in the snapshot; only the dependency version and the in-repo RequestContext exposing req.getContentType() are visible.", "A concrete OGNL payload defeating SecurityMemberAccess/OgnlUtil exclusions was not constructed or validated; impact is stated as potential RCE.", "Plugin-specific areas (REST XStream, Struts-1 message resources, config-browser, showcase apps) were reviewed at survey depth only, so additional distinct issues may exist there.", "Binary/static and generated template resources were excluded or not individually audited."]}
